purpose: Public reports matching the TB2 empty/gibberish cache-hit symptom; distinguish reproduction from proposed causes.

reports.match: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B SFT checkpoint; four decoding/cache arms, only MTP plus prefix caching reportedly loses approximately 20% accuracy.
reports.limits: Earlier vLLM, finetuned checkpoint and private classification benchmark; does not quantify our TB2 gap. Closed issue is not proof all related mechanisms are fixed.

reports.match: vLLM 0.28.0, hybrid Qwen3.5 GDN/full-attention, MTP plus prefix caching, empty or punctuation output with normal HTTP and finish reason.
reports.limits: Initial model is dense 27B FP8, not our MoE BF16. Several distinct mechanisms and withdrawn claims coexist in the discussion. API confirms issue remains open.

reports.match: MTP3 plus prefix caching on a Qwen3.6-derived hybrid model disrupts tool calls and long-context recall while a no-MTP cache arm works.
reports.limits: Quantized derivative checkpoint, different hardware/version. Symptom-level corroboration, not identical implementation root cause.

mechanisms.claim: Pending D2H accepted-count copy and batch-row moves have inconsistent ownership. A later previous-position gather can permute already reordered counts twice. Count selects conv shift and GDN snapshot, corrupting recurrent state.
mechanisms.author_reported_gpu_results: MTP+cache+async 16/288 wrong; async-off 0/288; candidate patch 0/288. Separate nightly comparison 29/1248 versus 0/1248 patched.
mechanisms.our_evidence: Prior AST-extracted CPU fixture demonstrates count-ownership mismatch under an explicit batch permutation. Live request row mapping/event timing not captured; GPU patch verification not performed.

mechanisms.claim: Speculative conv-state shift may copy overlapping ranges within a physical state block. Parallel memcpy does not guarantee memmove ordering; repair uses ordered overlap-safe copies.
mechanisms.our_evidence: Prior inspected source and CPU interleaving illustration identify a candidate; no local CUDA-kernel regression or live-model causal test.

mechanisms.review_counterpoint: Review comment states Mamba need not handle an additional drop because the full-attention group has already dropped a block.
mechanisms.our_evidence: Prior complete-coordinator CPU test independently shows native common hit4 and naive additional-drop hit0. Standalone ignored-flag inspection is insufficient.
mechanisms.decision: Do not infer the live root cause or deploy the extra-drop patch from the issue title alone.

conclusion: Multiple public symptom-level reproductions strongly justify investigating the hybrid prefix-cache/speculation state lifecycle. They do not establish which concrete bug caused our incident. Normal generation KV caching itself is not shown to be fundamentally unsafe.
next_discriminators: On an isolated GPU instance, preserve prefix reuse and MTP while comparing async on/off with matched cache exposure.
Separately test overlap-copy correctness against immutable snapshots and saved-prompt model replay.
Capture accepted counts with request IDs and batch permutations before declaring a particular root cause.

original_issue_closure.mechanism: Concurrent chunked prefills can stop mid-Mamba-block past last_cache_position. A running state at e.g. token364 is later hashed as state@1600. A subsequent prefix hit restores a truncated state labelled as the complete block boundary.
original_issue_closure.fix: Enforce intermediate prefill chunk alignment until prefill_end, and enforce realignment for unaligned starts. Preserve last_cache_position as a mandatory stop.
original_issue_closure.scope: This merged scheduler repair closed issue43559; later issue53912 still reproduces related symptoms, so closure is not evidence of a universal cure.

latest_closely_matching_report.finding: Additional cache-block-drop patch48375 did not prevent a new garbled output at ~57.7k prompt tokens. A real GPU overlap-copy regression failed without50729 and passed with it.
latest_closely_matching_report.limits: Author reports serving with both patches and monitoring; no completed long-term generation outcome is posted in that latest followup. This supports prioritizing the overlap-copy candidate, not declaring our cause proved.

deployment: No main-service changes, restart, GPU job submission or candidate deployment performed.
